title: With hardship comes ease
arabic: فإن مع العسر يسرا إن مع العسر يسرا
transliteration: Fa inna ma'al-'usri yusra. Inna ma'al-'usri yusra.
english_translation: Indeed, with hardship comes ease. Indeed, with hardship comes ease.
roman_urdu_translation: Beshak mushkil ke saath aasani hai. Beshak mushkil ke saath aasani hai.
explanation: Said twice for emphasis, these verses remind the reader that difficulty is not the whole story.

title: In the remembrance of Allah hearts find rest
arabic: ألا بذكر الله تطمئن القلوب
transliteration: Ala bidhikrillahi tatma'innul-qulub.
english_translation: Surely, in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.
roman_urdu_translation: Khabardar! Allah ke zikr se hi dilon ko itminan milta hai.
explanation: Describes the calm that comes to a believing heart through remembering Allah. It is not a promise that every worry will vanish.

title: Do not despair of the mercy of Allah
arabic: قل يا عبادي الذين أسرفوا على أنفسهم لا تقنطوا من رحمة الله إن الله يغفر الذنوب جميعا إنه هو الغفور الرحيم
transliteration: Qul ya 'ibadiyal-ladhina asrafu 'ala anfusihim la taqnatu min rahmatillah, innallaha yaghfirudh-dhunuba jami'a, innahu huwal-ghafurur-rahim.
english_translation: Say: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah. Indeed, Allah forgives all sins. Indeed, it is He who is the Forgiving, the Merciful.
roman_urdu_translation: Keh do: Ae mere bando jinhon ne apni jaanon par ziyadti ki, Allah ki rehmat se mayoos na ho. Beshak Allah tamam gunah maaf kar deta hai. Beshak woh bohat bakhshne wala, meherbaan hai.
explanation: An open invitation to those weighed down by their sins: despair is not the believer's answer to sin.

title: Whoever relies upon Allah, He is sufficient for them
arabic: ومن يتوكل على الله فهو حسبه إن الله بالغ أمره قد جعل الله لكل شيء قدرا
transliteration: Wa man yatawakkal 'alallahi fahuwa hasbuh. Innallaha balighu amrih. Qad ja'alallahu likulli shay'in qadra.
english_translation: And whoever relies upon Allah, then He is sufficient for them. Indeed, Allah will accomplish His purpose. Allah has set a measure for everything.
roman_urdu_translation: Aur jo Allah par bharosa karta hai to woh uske liye kaafi hai. Beshak Allah apna kaam poora kar ke rehta hai. Allah ne har cheez ka ek andaza muqarrar kar rakha hai.
explanation: Encourages trust in Allah. Scholars explain that reliance includes taking sensible means while leaving the outcome with Him.

title: Allah does not burden a soul beyond its capacity
arabic: لا يكلف الله نفسا إلا وسعها لها ما كسبت وعليها ما اكتسبت
transliteration: La yukallifullahu nafsan illa wus'aha, laha ma kasabat wa 'alayha maktasabat.
english_translation: Allah does not burden a soul beyond its capacity. It will have what it has earned, and it will bear what it has earned.
roman_urdu_translation: Allah kisi jaan par uski taqat se ziyada bojh nahin daalta. Jo usne kamaya woh usi ka hai aur jo usne kiya uska bojh usi par hai.
explanation: A reassurance that what Allah asks of a person is within what the person can bear.

title: Seek help through patience and prayer
arabic: يا أيها الذين آمنوا استعينوا بالصبر والصلاة إن الله مع الصابرين
transliteration: Ya ayyuhal-ladhina amanus-ta'inu bis-sabri was-salah, innallaha ma'as-sabirin.
english_translation: O you who believe, seek help through patience and prayer. Indeed, Allah is with the patient.
roman_urdu_translation: Ae iman walo! Sabr aur namaz se madad talab karo. Beshak Allah sabr karne walon ke saath hai.
explanation: Names two practical sources of strength during difficulty: patience and prayer.

title: Do not weaken and do not grieve
arabic: ولا تهنوا ولا تحزنوا وأنتم الأعلون إن كنتم مؤمنين
transliteration: Wa la tahinu wa la tahzanu wa antumul-a'lawna in kuntum mu'minin.
english_translation: Do not weaken and do not grieve, for you will be superior if you are believers.
roman_urdu_translation: Aur na himmat haro aur na gham karo, tum hi sarbuland rahoge agar tum momin ho.
explanation: Addressed to the believers after a painful setback, encouraging them not to be crushed by it.
context: Revealed in Surah Al 'Imran after the Battle of Uhud.

title: Do not grieve; indeed Allah is with us
arabic: لا تحزن إن الله معنا
transliteration: La tahzan innallaha ma'ana.
english_translation: Do not grieve; indeed Allah is with us.
roman_urdu_translation: Gham na kar, beshak Allah hamare saath hai.
explanation: The words the Prophet ﷺ said to his companion in the cave during their migration, when they were in danger.
context: Spoken by the Prophet ﷺ to Abu Bakr in the cave of Thawr.

title: Do not despair of Allah's relief
arabic: ولا تيأسوا من روح الله إنه لا ييأس من روح الله إلا القوم الكافرون
transliteration: Wa la tay'asu min rawhillah, innahu la yay'asu min rawhillahi illal-qawmul-kafirun.
english_translation: Do not despair of relief from Allah. Indeed, no one despairs of relief from Allah except the disbelieving people.
roman_urdu_translation: Aur Allah ki rehmat se mayoos na ho. Beshak Allah ki rehmat se woh log hi mayoos hote hain jo kafir hain.
explanation: Said by Prophet Ya'qub (peace be upon him) to his sons while he still grieved for Yusuf and hoped for his return.
context: Ya'qub (peace be upon him) said this to his sons.

title: I only complain of my sorrow and grief to Allah
arabic: إنما أشكو بثي وحزني إلى الله وأعلم من الله ما لا تعلمون
transliteration: Innama ashku baththi wa huzni ilallahi wa a'lamu minallahi ma la ta'lamun.
english_translation: He said: I only complain of my suffering and my grief to Allah, and I know from Allah what you do not know.
roman_urdu_translation: Unhon ne kaha: Main apni pareshani aur gham ki shikayat sirf Allah se karta hoon, aur Allah ki taraf se woh jaanta hoon jo tum nahin jaante.
explanation: A model for bringing sorrow openly to Allah, rather than hiding it.
context: The words of Prophet Ya'qub (peace be upon him) grieving for his son Yusuf.

title: Those who restrain anger and pardon people
arabic: والكاظمين الغيظ والعافين عن الناس والله يحب المحسنين
transliteration: Wal-kaziminal-ghayza wal-'afina 'anin-nas, wallahu yuhibbul-muhsinin.
english_translation: ...those who restrain anger and pardon people. And Allah loves the doers of good.
roman_urdu_translation: ...aur gussa pi jane wale aur logon ko maaf kar dene wale, aur Allah neki karne walon se mohabbat karta hai.
explanation: Part of a description of the righteous: they hold back anger and pardon others.
context: From Surah Al 'Imran, in a verse describing the people of taqwa.

title: Indeed I am near
arabic: وإذا سألك عبادي عني فإني قريب أجيب دعوة الداع إذا دعان فليستجيبوا لي وليؤمنوا بي لعلهم يرشدون
transliteration: Wa idha sa'alaka 'ibadi 'anni fa inni qarib, ujibu da'watad-da'i idha da'an, falyastajibu li walyu'minu bi la'allahum yarshudun.
english_translation: And when My servants ask you about Me — indeed I am near. I respond to the call of the caller when he calls on Me. So let them respond to Me and believe in Me, that they may be guided.
roman_urdu_translation: Aur jab mere bande aap se mere baare mein poochhein to (keh do) main qareeb hoon. Pukarne wale ki pukar ka jawab deta hoon jab woh mujhe pukare. Pas woh meri baat maanein aur mujh par iman rakhein taake hidayat pa jayen.
explanation: Allah describes Himself as near to those who call on Him. Scholars note that a response can take different forms and come in His timing.

title: We are closer to a person than the jugular vein
arabic: ونحن أقرب إليه من حبل الوريد
transliteration: Wa nahnu aqrabu ilayhi min hablil-warid.
english_translation: And We are closer to him than his jugular vein.
roman_urdu_translation: Aur hum us ki shah rag se bhi ziyada us ke qareeb hain.
explanation: Speaks of Allah's complete knowledge of the human being, who is never beyond His awareness.

title: Do not fear; I am with you, hearing and seeing
arabic: لا تخافا إنني معكما أسمع وأرى
transliteration: La takhafa innani ma'akuma asma'u wa ara.
english_translation: Do not fear. Indeed, I am with you both; I hear and I see.
roman_urdu_translation: Dar mat, main tum dono ke saath hoon, sunta aur dekhta hoon.
explanation: Allah's reassurance to Musa and Harun (peace be upon them) before facing Pharaoh.
context: Allah addressed Musa and Harun (peace be upon them) as they were sent to Pharaoh.

title: Perhaps you dislike something and it is good for you
arabic: وعسى أن تكرهوا شيئا وهو خير لكم وعسى أن تحبوا شيئا وهو شر لكم والله يعلم وأنتم لا تعلمون
transliteration: Wa 'asa an takrahu shay'an wa huwa khayrun lakum, wa 'asa an tuhibbu shay'an wa huwa sharrun lakum, wallahu ya'lamu wa antum la ta'lamun.
english_translation: Perhaps you dislike something while it is good for you, and perhaps you love something while it is bad for you. Allah knows, and you do not know.
roman_urdu_translation: Ho sakta hai tum kisi cheez ko na pasand karo aur woh tumhare liye behtar ho, aur ho sakta hai tum kisi cheez ko pasand karo aur woh tumhare liye buri ho. Allah jaanta hai aur tum nahin jaante.
explanation: A reminder that human judgment about what is good for us is limited.
context: From the verse about fighting being prescribed, addressing a case where the believers disliked something.

title: When you have decided, rely upon Allah
arabic: فإذا عزمت فتوكل على الله إن الله يحب المتوكلين
transliteration: Fa idha 'azamta fa tawakkal 'alallah, innallaha yuhibbul-mutawakkilin.
english_translation: Then when you have made a decision, rely upon Allah. Indeed, Allah loves those who rely upon Him.
roman_urdu_translation: Phir jab tum faisla kar lo to Allah par bharosa karo. Beshak Allah bharosa karne walon se mohabbat karta hai.
explanation: Follows an instruction to consult others: seek advice, decide, then trust Allah with the outcome.

title: Indeed we belong to Allah, and to Him we will return
arabic: الذين إذا أصابتهم مصيبة قالوا إنا لله وإنا إليه راجعون
transliteration: Alladhina idha asabat-hum musibatun qalu inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un.
english_translation: Those who, when a calamity strikes them, say: Indeed we belong to Allah, and indeed to Him we will return.
roman_urdu_translation: Woh log ke jab unhein koi museebat pahunchti hai to kehte hain: Hum Allah ke hain aur hamein usi ki taraf lautna hai.
explanation: The words the Quran describes for those who are patient when calamity strikes.

title: If you are grateful, I will give you more
arabic: لئن شكرتم لأزيدنكم ولئن كفرتم إن عذابي لشديد
transliteration: La'in shakartum la azidannakum, wa la'in kafartum inna 'adhabi lashadid.
english_translation: If you are grateful, I will surely increase you; but if you are ungrateful, indeed My punishment is severe.
roman_urdu_translation: Agar tum shukr karoge to main tumhein aur ziyada dunga, aur agar nashukri karoge to beshak mera azaab bohat sakht hai.
explanation: Allah's own statement about gratitude. Scholars discuss in what ways the 'increase' may come, and it is not limited to wealth.

title: Remember Me, and I will remember you
arabic: فاذكروني أذكركم واشكروا لي ولا تكفرون
transliteration: Fadhkuruni adhkurkum washkuru li wa la takfurun.
english_translation: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me, and do not be ungrateful to Me.
roman_urdu_translation: Pas tum mujhe yaad karo, main tumhein yaad karunga. Aur meri shukrguzari karo aur meri nashukri na karo.
explanation: An invitation to remember Allah, joined with a call to gratitude.

title: Allah loves those who repent
arabic: إن الله يحب التوابين ويحب المتطهرين
transliteration: Innallaha yuhibbut-tawwabina wa yuhibbul-mutatahhirin.
english_translation: Indeed, Allah loves those who repent and loves those who purify themselves.
roman_urdu_translation: Beshak Allah tauba karne walon se mohabbat karta hai aur paak rehne walon se mohabbat karta hai.
explanation: Presents repentance as something Allah loves, rather than something to be ashamed of.

title: I am Forgiving to whoever repents, believes and does good
arabic: وإني لغفار لمن تاب وآمن وعمل صالحا ثم اهتدى
transliteration: Wa inni laghaffarun liman taba wa amana wa 'amila salihan thumma ihtada.
english_translation: And indeed, I am the Most Forgiving to whoever repents, believes, does righteous deeds, and then remains guided.
roman_urdu_translation: Aur beshak main bohat bakhshne wala hoon uske liye jo tauba kare, iman laye, nek amal kare aur phir hidayat par qaim rahe.
explanation: States the pattern of repentance Allah describes: turn back, believe, act well, and stay on the path.

title: Allah is sufficient for me
arabic: حسبي الله لا إله إلا هو عليه توكلت وهو رب العرش العظيم
transliteration: Hasbiyallahu la ilaha illa huw, 'alayhi tawakkaltu wa huwa rabbul-'arshil-'azim.
english_translation: Allah is sufficient for me. There is no god but Him. In Him I have placed my trust, and He is the Lord of the Mighty Throne.
roman_urdu_translation: Mujhe Allah kaafi hai. Uske siwa koi mabood nahin. Maine usi par bharosa kiya aur woh azeem arsh ka Rab hai.
explanation: The Quran instructs the Prophet ﷺ to say this if people turn away. It is also used as a statement of reliance.
context: The final verse of Surat at-Tawbah.

title: Surat al-Ikhlas
arabic: قل هو الله أحد الله الصمد لم يلد ولم يولد ولم يكن له كفوا أحد
transliteration: Qul huwallahu ahad. Allahus-samad. Lam yalid wa lam yulad. Wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad.
english_translation: Say: He is Allah, the One. Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born, and there is none comparable to Him.
roman_urdu_translation: Keh do: Woh Allah ek hai. Allah be-niyaz hai. Na uski koi aulaad hai aur na woh kisi ki aulaad hai. Aur koi uska hamsar nahin.
explanation: A short statement of Allah's oneness. The Prophet ﷺ recited it with the next two surahs before sleeping.
repetition_note: Narrated for bedtime: recited, then blown into the palms and wiped over the body, three times (Sahih al-Bukhari 5017).

title: Surat al-Falaq
arabic: قل أعوذ برب الفلق من شر ما خلق ومن شر غاسق إذا وقب ومن شر النفاثات في العقد ومن شر حاسد إذا حسد
transliteration: Qul a'udhu birabbil-falaq. Min sharri ma khalaq. Wa min sharri ghasiqin idha waqab. Wa min sharrin-naffathati fil-'uqad. Wa min sharri hasidin idha hasad.
english_translation: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak, from the evil of what He has created, from the evil of the darkness when it settles, from the evil of those who blow on knots, and from the evil of an envier when he envies.
roman_urdu_translation: Keh do: Main subah ke Rab ki panah mangta hoon, har us cheez ke shar se jo usne paida ki, andheri raat ke shar se jab woh chha jaye, girahon mein phoonkne walon ke shar se, aur hasad karne wale ke shar se jab woh hasad kare.
explanation: Seeks refuge in Allah from evil in its different forms.
repetition_note: Narrated for bedtime: recited, then blown into the palms and wiped over the body, three times (Sahih al-Bukhari 5017).

title: Surat an-Nas
arabic: قل أعوذ برب الناس ملك الناس إله الناس من شر الوسواس الخناس الذي يوسوس في صدور الناس من الجنة والناس
transliteration: Qul a'udhu birabbin-nas. Malikin-nas. Ilahin-nas. Min sharril-waswasil-khannas. Alladhi yuwaswisu fi suduri-nas. Minal-jinnati wan-nas.
english_translation: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, the Sovereign of mankind, the God of mankind, from the evil of the whispering withdrawer, who whispers in the hearts of mankind — from among jinn and mankind.
roman_urdu_translation: Keh do: Main logon ke Rab ki panah mangta hoon, logon ke badshah ki, logon ke mabood ki, pichhe hat jane wale waswase daalne wale ke shar se, jo logon ke seenon mein waswase daalta hai, jinnon mein se ho ya insanon mein se.
explanation: Seeks refuge in Allah from the whispering that unsettles the heart.
repetition_note: Narrated for bedtime: recited, then blown into the palms and wiped over the body, three times (Sahih al-Bukhari 5017).

title: Ayat al-Kursi
arabic: الله لا إله إلا هو الحي القيوم لا تأخذه سنة ولا نوم له ما في السماوات وما في الأرض من ذا الذي يشفع عنده إلا بإذنه يعلم ما بين أيديهم وما خلفهم ولا يحيطون بشيء من علمه إلا بما شاء وسع كرسيه السماوات والأرض ولا يئوده حفظهما وهو العلي العظيم
transliteration: Allahu la ilaha illa huwal-hayyul-qayyum. La ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa la nawm. Lahu ma fis-samawati wa ma fil-ard. Man dhal-ladhi yashfa'u 'indahu illa bi-idhnih. Ya'lamu ma bayna aydihim wa ma khalfahum, wa la yuhituna bishay'in min 'ilmihi illa bima sha'. Wasi'a kursiyyuhus-samawati wal-ard, wa la ya'uduhu hifzuhuma, wa huwal-'aliyyul-'azim.
english_translation: Allah — there is no god but Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all existence. Neither drowsiness nor sleep overtakes Him. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is before them and what is behind them, and they encompass nothing of His knowledge except what He wills. His Throne extends over the heavens and the earth, and preserving them does not tire Him. And He is the Most High, the Almighty.
roman_urdu_translation: Allah, uske siwa koi mabood nahin, woh zinda hai, sab ko thamne wala hai. Use na unghh aati hai na neend. Usi ka hai jo aasmanon mein hai aur jo zameen mein hai. Kaun hai jo uske huzoor uski ijazat ke baghair sifarish kare? Woh jaanta hai jo unke saamne hai aur jo unke peechhe hai, aur woh uske ilm mein se kisi cheez ka ehata nahin kar sakte magar jitna woh chahe. Uski kursi aasmanon aur zameen par chhai hui hai aur in dono ki hifazat use thakati nahin, aur woh bohat buland, bohat azeem hai.
explanation: The most renowned verse of the Quran, describing Allah's life, sovereignty and knowledge.
context: In the narration of Abu Hurayrah (may Allah be pleased with him), a guard from Allah stays with the one who recites it at night (Sahih al-Bukhari 2311).

title: The last two verses of Surat al-Baqarah
arabic: آمن الرسول بما أنزل إليه من ربه والمؤمنون كل آمن بالله وملائكته وكتبه ورسله لا نفرق بين أحد من رسله وقالوا سمعنا وأطعنا غفرانك ربنا وإليك المصير لا يكلف الله نفسا إلا وسعها لها ما كسبت وعليها ما اكتسبت ربنا لا تؤاخذنا إن نسينا أو أخطأنا ربنا ولا تحمل علينا إصرا كما حملته على الذين من قبلنا ربنا ولا تحملنا ما لا طاقة لنا به واعف عنا واغفر لنا وارحمنا أنت مولانا فانصرنا على القوم الكافرين
transliteration: Amanar-rasulu bima unzila ilayhi mir-rabbihi wal-mu'minun, kullun amana billahi wa mala'ikatihi wa kutubihi wa rusulih, la nufarriqu bayna ahadin mir-rusulih, wa qalu sami'na wa ata'na ghufranaka rabbana wa ilaykal-masir. La yukallifullahu nafsan illa wus'aha, laha ma kasabat wa 'alayha maktasabat. Rabbana la tu'akhidhna in nasina aw akhta'na. Rabbana wa la tahmil 'alayna isran kama hamaltahu 'alal-ladhina min qablina. Rabbana wa la tuhammilna ma la taqata lana bih, wa'fu 'anna waghfir lana warhamna, anta mawlana fansurna 'alal-qawmil-kafirin.
english_translation: The Messenger believes in what was sent down to him from his Lord, and so do the believers. All of them believe in Allah, His angels, His Books and His messengers: 'We make no distinction between any of His messengers.' And they say: 'We hear and we obey. Your forgiveness, our Lord, and to You is the final return.' Allah does not burden a soul beyond its capacity. It will have what it has earned, and it will bear what it has earned. Our Lord, do not hold us accountable if we forget or make a mistake. Our Lord, do not place on us a burden like the one You placed on those before us. Our Lord, do not burden us with what we have no strength to bear. Pardon us, forgive us and have mercy on us. You are our Protector, so help us against the disbelieving people.
roman_urdu_translation: Rasool us par iman laye jo unke Rab ki taraf se un par utara gaya, aur momin bhi. Sab Allah par, uske farishton par, uski kitabon par aur uske rasoolon par iman laye. Hum uske rasoolon mein se kisi mein farq nahin karte. Aur unhon ne kaha: Humne suna aur maana. Ae hamare Rab! Teri bakhshish chahiye aur teri hi taraf lautna hai. Allah kisi jaan par uski taqat se ziyada bojh nahin daalta. Jo usne kamaya woh usi ka hai aur jo kiya uska bojh usi par hai. Ae hamare Rab! Agar hum bhool jayen ya ghalti karein to hamein na pakad. Ae hamare Rab! Hum par woh bojh na daal jo tu ne hum se pehle logon par dala. Ae hamare Rab! Hum se woh na uthwa jis ki hamein taqat nahin. Hamein maaf kar de, bakhsh de aur hum par raham farma. Tu hi hamara maula hai, to kafir qaum ke muqable mein hamari madad farma.
explanation: The closing verses of Surat al-Baqarah. The Prophet ﷺ said that whoever recites them at night, they will suffice him; scholars explain this in several ways.
context: Recited at night, as narrated in Sahih al-Bukhari 5009 and Sahih Muslim 807.

supporting_hadith.check_text: من قرأ بالآيتين من آخر سورة البقرة
